_note: Import through Master Admin > Report Builder > Import JSON. Shopify sections are platform-gated; product checks are additionally gated to pages with Product JSON-LD.

sections.name: Shopify Performance & App Bloat
sections.shortDescription: Theme delivery, app-script overhead, and image loading signals that affect storefront speed.
sections.detailedDescription: Checks Shopify-specific script overhead, resource hints, responsive image delivery, layout stability, and loading priority using the stored audit snapshot.
sections.adminNotes: Thresholds are intentionally conservative. Tune app-count bands only after measuring a larger production cohort; app count is a diagnostic proxy, not proof that an app is slow.

fields.name: Third-Party App Script Hosts
fields.description: Counts third-party script hosts that appear to belong to Shopify apps.

PASS.message: The storefront loads scripts from {{count}} detected app host(s).
PASS.suggestion: Keep reviewing app usage during quarterly theme maintenance so unused integrations do not accumulate.

FAIL.message: The storefront loads scripts from {{count}} detected app hosts, which is a strong app-bloat signal.
FAIL.suggestion: Open Shopify admin > Settings > Apps and sales channels. Remove unused apps, then inspect Online Store > Themes > Edit code for snippets left behind by uninstalled apps.

WARNING.message: The storefront loads scripts from {{count}} detected app hosts.
WARNING.suggestion: Review each app against the revenue or operational value it provides. Remove redundant apps and retest the theme after cleanup.

fields.name: Parser-Blocking App Scripts
fields.description: Counts third-party app scripts that load without async, defer, or module semantics.

PASS.message: No parser-blocking third-party app scripts were detected.
PASS.suggestion: Keep non-critical app scripts deferred and verify this after every app or theme change.

FAIL.message: {{count}} parser-blocking app scripts were detected.
FAIL.suggestion: In Online Store > Themes > Edit code, inspect theme.liquid and app snippets. Remove orphaned tags and ask remaining app vendors for async, deferred, or theme-app-extension loading.

WARNING.suggestion: Confirm each blocking script is needed before first paint. Defer non-critical integrations and retest the storefront.

fields.name: Shopify CDN Connection Hint
fields.description: Checks for a preconnect or DNS-prefetch hint to cdn.shopify.com.

PASS.message: The page provides a connection hint for Shopify's CDN.
PASS.suggestion: Keep the hint early in the document head and avoid duplicate hints.

FAIL.message: No connection hint for cdn.shopify.com was found.
FAIL.suggestion: In Online Store > Themes > Edit code, add a preconnect link for https://cdn.shopify.com near the top of theme.liquid when critical assets use that host.

WARNING.message: The Shopify CDN connection hint needs review.
WARNING.suggestion: Keep one early preconnect for cdn.shopify.com and remove redundant resource hints.

fields.name: Responsive Shopify CDN Images
fields.description: Checks whether every detected Shopify CDN image URL includes a responsive width parameter.

PASS.message: All detected Shopify CDN images use width-aware URLs.
PASS.suggestion: Keep using image_url with explicit widths and image_tag with widths and sizes.

FAIL.message: Some Shopify CDN images do not use a responsive width parameter.
FAIL.suggestion: In the relevant Liquid section or snippet, replace full-size image URLs with image_url: width: ... and render them with image_tag widths and sizes so mobile devices receive smaller files.

WARNING.message: Responsive Shopify image delivery needs review.
WARNING.suggestion: Verify each above-the-fold image has width-specific src and srcset candidates.

fields.name: Explicit Image Dimensions
fields.description: Checks whether every image declares width and height to reserve layout space.

PASS.message: All detected images declare width and height.
PASS.suggestion: Keep dimensions in image_tag output so the browser can reserve space before files load.

FAIL.message: One or more images omit width or height, increasing layout-shift risk.
FAIL.suggestion: Use Shopify's image_tag filter or add width and height attributes in the responsible section/snippet. Start with hero, product, and collection-card images.

WARNING.suggestion: Inspect the rendered image markup and ensure width and height are emitted for each content image.

fields.name: Responsive Srcset Coverage
fields.description: Measures the average number of srcset candidates per image.

PASS.message: Images average {{actualValue}} srcset candidates.
PASS.suggestion: Keep a useful spread of widths aligned to the theme's actual breakpoints.

FAIL.message: Images do not provide enough responsive srcset choices.
FAIL.suggestion: Use image_tag with a widths list and a correct sizes attribute in product cards, product media, banners, and editorial sections.

WARNING.suggestion: Add more width candidates so phones and smaller viewports are not forced to download desktop-sized images.

fields.name: Above-the-Fold Image Priority
fields.description: Checks that at least one of the first three images is not lazy-loaded.

PASS.message: At least one early image is loaded eagerly.
PASS.suggestion: Keep the likely LCP image eager and consider fetchpriority=high only for that single critical image.

FAIL.message: The first images are all lazy-loaded, which can delay the largest visible image.
FAIL.suggestion: In the hero or product-media section, set the likely LCP image to loading: 'eager'. Do not make every image eager.

WARNING.message: Early image loading priority needs review.
WARNING.suggestion: Make only the likely LCP image eager and leave below-the-fold media lazy-loaded.

fields.name: Below-the-Fold Lazy Loading
fields.description: Checks for lazy loading on image-heavy pages.

PASS.message: Lazy loading is used for non-critical imagery.
PASS.suggestion: Keep above-the-fold media eager and below-the-fold media lazy.

FAIL.message: This image-heavy page does not expose lazy-loaded images.
FAIL.suggestion: In product-card, collection, and editorial snippets, use image_tag with loading: 'lazy' for images below the initial viewport.

WARNING.suggestion: Check that below-the-fold images are lazy without delaying the hero or main product image.

sections.name: Shopify Store Policies
sections.shortDescription: Checks Shopify's fixed policy pages for coverage, substance, and avoidable duplicate headings.
sections.detailedDescription: Verifies the refund, privacy, terms, and shipping policy routes and reviews the policy set for thin content and duplicated title/H1 text.
sections.adminNotes: Legal notice is included in aggregate coverage but is not an individual scored check because jurisdictional requirements differ.

fields.name: Refund Policy Published
fields.description: Checks Shopify's /policies/refund-policy route.

PASS.message: A refund policy is published at Shopify's standard policy route.
PASS.suggestion: Review it whenever return windows, fees, or exclusions change.

FAIL.message: No refund policy was found at Shopify's standard policy route.
FAIL.suggestion: Open Shopify admin > Settings > Policies, add the refund policy, save it, and link it from the footer and relevant product pages.

WARNING.suggestion: Confirm the policy is published, current, and linked from the storefront.

fields.name: Privacy Policy Published
fields.description: Checks Shopify's /policies/privacy-policy route.

PASS.message: A privacy policy is published at Shopify's standard policy route.
PASS.suggestion: Keep the policy aligned with installed apps, analytics, advertising, and customer-data practices.

FAIL.message: No privacy policy was found at Shopify's standard policy route.
FAIL.suggestion: Open Shopify admin > Settings > Policies, publish the privacy policy, and link it from the footer and consent surfaces.

WARNING.suggestion: Confirm the policy is published and reflects the store's current data handling.

fields.name: Terms of Service Published
fields.description: Checks Shopify's /policies/terms-of-service route.

PASS.message: Terms of service are published at Shopify's standard policy route.
PASS.suggestion: Review the terms after material changes to checkout, subscriptions, or fulfillment.

FAIL.message: No terms of service were found at Shopify's standard policy route.
FAIL.suggestion: Open Shopify admin > Settings > Policies, add terms of service, and expose the link in the storefront footer.

WARNING.message: The terms of service need review.
WARNING.suggestion: Confirm the route is public and the content matches current selling practices.

fields.name: Shipping Policy Published
fields.description: Checks Shopify's /policies/shipping-policy route.

PASS.message: A shipping policy is published at Shopify's standard policy route.
PASS.suggestion: Keep delivery regions, processing times, rates, duties, and tracking expectations current.

FAIL.message: No shipping policy was found at Shopify's standard policy route.
FAIL.suggestion: Open Shopify admin > Settings > Policies, publish shipping terms, and link them near product and cart decisions as well as in the footer.

WARNING.suggestion: Confirm the route is public and its promises match current fulfillment operations.

fields.name: Core Policy Coverage
fields.description: Counts published pages across Shopify's five fixed policy routes.

PASS.message: {{count}} of Shopify's five policy routes are published.
PASS.suggestion: Keep the policy set linked, current, and consistent with checkout operations.

FAIL.message: Only {{count}} of Shopify's five policy routes are published.
FAIL.suggestion: Use Shopify admin > Settings > Policies to complete the relevant refund, privacy, terms, shipping, and legal-notice pages for the store's jurisdictions.

WARNING.message: {{count}} of Shopify's five policy routes are published.
WARNING.suggestion: Complete the missing core policies and expose them from the footer.

fields.name: Policy Content Depth
fields.description: Counts published policy pages with fewer than roughly 100 words.

PASS.message: No published policy page was flagged as thin.
PASS.suggestion: Keep each policy specific to the store rather than relying on unchanged boilerplate.

FAIL.message: {{count}} published policy pages contain very little content.
FAIL.suggestion: In Shopify admin > Settings > Policies, expand each thin page with the actual timeframes, conditions, exclusions, contact route, and regional details customers need.

WARNING.message: One published policy page appears thin.
WARNING.suggestion: Expand it with store-specific terms and plain-language operational details.

fields.name: Distinct Policy Title and H1
fields.description: Counts policy pages where the browser title exactly repeats the H1.

PASS.message: Policy pages avoid exact title-and-H1 duplication.
PASS.suggestion: Keep search titles descriptive while leaving the on-page heading concise.

FAIL.message: {{count}} policy pages repeat the same text in the title and H1.
FAIL.suggestion: Edit the policy template's SEO title output in Online Store > Themes > Edit code so it adds useful store context instead of copying the H1 verbatim.

WARNING.message: One policy page repeats the same title and H1.
WARNING.suggestion: Give its browser title useful context such as the store name while keeping the visible H1 natural.

sections.name: Shopify Product Page Readiness
sections.shortDescription: Product schema completeness and customer decision support on Shopify product pages.
sections.detailedDescription: Runs only for Shopify and Hydrogen pages containing Product JSON-LD. Homepage audits correctly skip every check in this section.
sections.adminNotes: Every field is gated by shopify.product.hasProductSchema. Static-HTML themes that inject Product JSON-LD client-side remain N/A unless the render decision supplies the DOM.

fields.name: Product schema present
fields.description: Checks that the product page publishes Product (or ProductGroup) structured data — what Google Shopping and AI answer engines read.

PASS.message: This product page publishes Product structured data.
PASS.suggestion: Keep it in sync when you change themes — schema usually lives in the theme, not the product record.

FAIL.message: This product page publishes no Product structured data, so Google Shopping and AI shopping assistants cannot read its price, availability or reviews.
FAIL.suggestion: Most themes emit this from a JSON-LD block in Sections > main-product.liquid (or snippets/product-json-ld.liquid). If your theme omits it, add the block or install a structured-data app rather than editing every template.

WARNING.message: Product structured data was detected but could not be fully parsed.
WARNING.suggestion: Validate the page with Google Rich Results Test and fix any JSON-LD syntax errors.

fields.name: Product Offers Schema
fields.description: Checks that Product JSON-LD includes an offers object.

PASS.message: Product JSON-LD includes offer data.
PASS.suggestion: Keep offer markup synchronized with the selected variant and visible product information.

FAIL.message: Product JSON-LD is present but has no offers object.
FAIL.suggestion: Update the product structured-data snippet in Online Store > Themes > Edit code so Product includes Offer or AggregateOffer data generated from Shopify product and variant values.

WARNING.suggestion: Validate the page with Google's Rich Results Test and ensure the offer matches the storefront.

fields.name: Product Price Schema
fields.description: Checks that Product offers expose price or priceSpecification.

PASS.message: Product offer markup includes a price.
PASS.suggestion: Keep schema price synchronized with the visible selected-variant price.

FAIL.message: Product offer markup does not expose a price.
FAIL.suggestion: Update the theme's product JSON-LD to output the current variant price using Shopify's money value, without currency symbols in the numeric field.

WARNING.suggestion: Validate that a numeric price is present and agrees with the storefront.

fields.name: Product Availability Schema
fields.description: Checks that Product offers expose availability.

PASS.message: Product offer markup includes availability.
PASS.suggestion: Keep availability synchronized with Shopify inventory and the selected variant.

FAIL.message: Product offer markup does not expose availability.
FAIL.suggestion: Update the product structured-data snippet to emit the correct schema.org InStock, OutOfStock, PreOrder, or BackOrder URL from Shopify inventory state.

WARNING.suggestion: Validate the emitted availability against the selected variant's actual inventory state.

fields.name: Product Currency Schema
fields.description: Checks that Product offers expose priceCurrency.

PASS.message: Product offer markup includes a currency.
PASS.suggestion: Keep priceCurrency aligned with the market and visible product price.

FAIL.message: Product offer markup does not expose priceCurrency.
FAIL.suggestion: Update the theme's product JSON-LD to emit a valid three-letter currency code from Shopify's active currency.

WARNING.suggestion: Confirm priceCurrency is present and matches the price shown to the visitor.

fields.name: Aggregate Rating Schema
fields.description: Checks whether Product JSON-LD includes aggregateRating.

PASS.message: Product JSON-LD includes aggregate rating data.
PASS.suggestion: Keep rating counts synchronized with visible, genuine reviews.

FAIL.message: No aggregate rating was found in Product JSON-LD.
FAIL.suggestion: If the product has genuine visible reviews, configure the review app or theme integration to add matching aggregateRating markup. Do not fabricate ratings.

WARNING.suggestion: Only publish rating schema when the same reviews are visible to customers on the page.

fields.name: Product Schema Image Set
fields.description: Counts images exposed by the Product JSON-LD image property.

PASS.message: Product schema exposes {{count}} images.
PASS.suggestion: Keep the image list aligned with strong, indexable product media.

FAIL.message: Product schema does not expose a usable image.
FAIL.suggestion: Update the product JSON-LD snippet to include at least the featured product image, using an absolute Shopify CDN URL.

WARNING.suggestion: Include additional high-quality product angles in the Product image array when they are available on the page.

fields.name: Size Guidance
fields.description: Looks for size-guide or size-chart language on the product page.
fields.adminNotes: This is a merchandising opportunity, not a universal compliance requirement; keep the low severity because non-sized products legitimately fail it.

PASS.message: Size guidance is visible on the product page.
PASS.suggestion: Keep measurements product-specific and easy to open near the variant selector.

FAIL.message: No size guide or size chart was detected.
FAIL.suggestion: If this product has fit or dimension choices, add a size-guide block near the selector using a product metafield or metaobject. Ignore this recommendation for products where sizing does not apply.

WARNING.suggestion: Confirm shoppers can find product-specific measurements before choosing a variant.

fields.name: Shipping Information on Product Page
fields.description: Looks for shipping or delivery language on the product page.

PASS.message: Shipping or delivery information is visible on the product page.
PASS.suggestion: Keep estimates, regional limits, and any free-shipping threshold accurate.

FAIL.message: No shipping or delivery information was detected on the product page.
FAIL.suggestion: Add a concise shipping block or collapsible row in Online Store > Themes > Customize > Product template, with a link to the full shipping policy.

WARNING.suggestion: Place the key delivery promise close to the purchase decision and link to full terms.

fields.name: Returns Information on Product Page
fields.description: Looks for returns or refund language on the product page.

PASS.message: Returns or refund information is visible on the product page.
PASS.suggestion: Keep the summary consistent with the full refund policy.

FAIL.message: No returns or refund information was detected on the product page.
FAIL.suggestion: Add a concise returns row in Online Store > Themes > Customize > Product template and link it to /policies/refund-policy.

WARNING.suggestion: State the return window and main exclusions near the buying decision, then link to full terms.

sections.name: Shopify URL & Indexing Hygiene
sections.shortDescription: Duplicate-prone product links, parameterized URLs, and Shopify sitemap discovery.
sections.detailedDescription: Reviews links exposed by the audited page for collection-scoped product paths and query parameters that can expand crawl space, plus Shopify sitemap children.
sections.adminNotes: Parameter counts are page-local signals, not proof of indexation. Confirm canonical tags and Search Console evidence before blocking useful filters or variants.

fields.name: Canonical Product Link Shape
fields.description: Detects /collections/{handle}/products/{handle} links that create alternate product paths.

PASS.message: No collection-scoped product links were detected.
PASS.suggestion: Keep internal links pointed at /products/{handle} and retain self-referencing product canonicals.

FAIL.message: The page links to collection-scoped product URLs that can expose alternate product paths.
FAIL.suggestion: In product-card and collection snippets, remove the within: collection URL pattern and link to product.url so internal links resolve to /products/{handle}.

WARNING.suggestion: Verify product cards link directly to canonical /products/{handle} URLs.

fields.name: Variant Parameter Link Volume
fields.description: Counts links containing the Shopify ?variant= parameter.

PASS.message: Variant-parameter links are controlled on this page ({{count}} found).
PASS.suggestion: Keep canonicals on the base product URL unless a variant page intentionally deserves separate indexing.

FAIL.message: This page exposes {{count}} links with ?variant= parameters.
FAIL.suggestion: Review theme and swatch links. Preserve variant selection for shoppers, but avoid generating large crawlable sets when the base product URL can carry the experience.

WARNING.suggestion: Confirm variant URLs canonicalize correctly and that internal linking is not multiplying near-duplicate pages.

fields.name: Filter Parameter Link Volume
fields.description: Counts links containing Shopify collection filter parameters.

PASS.message: Filter-parameter links are controlled on this page ({{count}} found).
PASS.suggestion: Keep useful storefront filtering while monitoring which combinations search engines crawl.

FAIL.message: This page exposes {{count}} filter-parameter links, creating a large crawl-space risk.
FAIL.suggestion: Review Shopify Search & Discovery filters and theme link generation. Keep customer-useful facets, but avoid linking every low-value filter combination.

WARNING.suggestion: Check Search Console and canonical behavior before changing filters; the count is a crawl-space signal, not proof of duplicate indexation.

fields.name: Pagination Parameter Link Volume
fields.description: Counts links containing ?page= pagination parameters.

PASS.message: Pagination links are controlled on this page ({{count}} found).
PASS.suggestion: Keep paginated collection pages crawlable when they are needed to discover products.

FAIL.message: This page exposes {{count}} pagination links.
FAIL.suggestion: Inspect collection pagination in the active theme. Avoid generating redundant page links, but do not hide product discovery from crawlers.

WARNING.suggestion: Verify the pagination is intentional, canonical behavior is consistent, and products remain discoverable.

fields.name: Shopify Child Sitemaps
fields.description: Checks the sitemap index for Shopify product or collection child sitemaps.

PASS.message: The sitemap index exposes Shopify product or collection child sitemaps.
PASS.suggestion: Keep /sitemap.xml accessible and submit it to the relevant search-engine webmaster tools.

FAIL.message: No Shopify product or collection child sitemap was detected.
FAIL.suggestion: Check /sitemap.xml directly, confirm storefront password protection is off for production, and verify no proxy or robots rule is replacing Shopify's generated sitemap.

WARNING.message: Shopify child sitemap discovery needs review.
WARNING.suggestion: Confirm /sitemap.xml lists the expected product and collection sitemap files.

sections.name: AI Discoverability
sections.shortDescription: Machine-readable signals that help answer engines understand and cite the site.
sections.detailedDescription: Checks for a real root-level llms.txt file, basic file substance, a recognizable heading, and structured data. llms.txt is an emerging convention, so its checks carry modest weight.
sections.adminNotes: Universal section: do not add a Shopify platform gate. llms.txt is emerging rather than a formal ranking requirement, so absence is low severity.

fields.name: llms.txt Available
fields.description: Checks for a non-HTML 200 response at /llms.txt.

PASS.message: A text llms.txt file is available at the site root.
PASS.suggestion: Keep it concise, factual, and synchronized with the site's canonical pages.

FAIL.message: No valid llms.txt file was found at /llms.txt.
FAIL.suggestion: Publish a plain-text /llms.txt that identifies the site and links to the most useful canonical content. On Shopify, this may require an app proxy, edge route, or supported routing integration.

WARNING.suggestion: Confirm it returns plain text with a 200 response rather than an HTML soft-404 page.

fields.name: llms.txt Substance
fields.description: Checks that llms.txt contains more than a token placeholder.

PASS.message: llms.txt contains {{count}} bytes of content.
PASS.suggestion: Keep the file focused on identity, key sections, and canonical references rather than copying the whole site.

FAIL.message: llms.txt contains only {{count}} bytes and appears to be a placeholder.
FAIL.suggestion: Add a clear site heading, short description, and curated links to primary product, collection, policy, support, and editorial pages.

WARNING.message: llms.txt is present but brief at {{count}} bytes.
WARNING.suggestion: Add enough context and canonical links to make the file useful without turning it into a content dump.

fields.name: llms.txt Primary Heading
fields.description: Checks that llms.txt begins with a Markdown H1 heading.

PASS.message: llms.txt starts with a clear Markdown H1.
PASS.suggestion: Use the official brand or site name and keep the description immediately below it accurate.

FAIL.message: llms.txt does not start with a recognizable Markdown H1.
FAIL.suggestion: Begin the file with '# Brand or Site Name', followed by a concise description and curated Markdown links.

WARNING.suggestion: Use one clear top-level heading before the descriptive text and link groups.

fields.name: Structured Data Present
fields.description: Checks for JSON-LD that gives machines explicit entity and content context.

PASS.message: The page includes JSON-LD structured data.
PASS.suggestion: Keep the markup valid and aligned with visible page content.

FAIL.message: No JSON-LD structured data was detected.
FAIL.suggestion: Add schema appropriate to the page type. For Shopify, verify the active theme outputs Organization/WebSite context and Product data on product templates.

WARNING.suggestion: Validate the page's JSON-LD and remove stale or conflicting blocks from old apps and theme snippets.
